To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the modified homogeneous pressure drop correlation with the effective viscosity for the liquid and vapor phases and the modified Kandlikar heat transfer correlation for FC-72 with the proposed FFl = 0.747 are useful for predicting the heat transfer coefficient and pressure drop in small channel heat sink applications.

the heat transfer coefficient and pressure drop of FC-72 were measured in small channel heat sink with circular cross-sections, and the existing correlations were modified to predict the pressure drop and heat transfer coefficient of FC-72 with average deviations of less than 1% and 8%, respectively.

the pressure drop and heat transfer characteristics of FC-072 in small channel heat sink were successfully predicted by using the modified homogeneous model and Kandlikar’s correlation with FFl = 0.747 for the fluid surface parameter.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a small channel heat sink with a high heat flux capacity and low pressure drop.
the heat transfer and flow characteristics in small channel heat sink with FC-72.
the heat transfer characteristics of FC-73 and the pressure drop in small channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the modified homogeneous model with the new fluid surface parameter is recommended for predicting the pressure drop and heat transfer coefficient of FC-72 flowing in small channels.
the existing correlations for pressure drop and heat transfer can be used for the prediction of FC-72 heat transfer and pressure drops in small channel heat sink with a small modification.
the present data are consistent with the predictions of the modified homogeneous pressure drop models, and the Kandlikar correlations with a new FFl = 0.747 for the FC-72.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the present data and correlations would be useful for the design and optimization of small channel heat sinks for electronic cooling.
the existing correlations could predict the heat transfer coefficients and the pressure drops of FC 72 in small channels with reasonable accuracy.

the modified homogeneous pressure drop correlation can predict the pressure drop of FC-72 flowing in the small channel heat sinks with an accuracy of ±27%, and the Kandlikar heat transfer correlation with the fluid-surface parameter can predict the heat transfer coefficient of FC-72 with an accuracy of ±7% for the small channel heat sink.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the existing heat transfer and pressure correlations are applicable to small channel heat sinks with the proposed fluid surface parameter for FC-72.
the existing heat transfer and pressure loss correlations can be applied to the small channel heat sinks for FC-72 with appropriate fluid properties.
the existing correlations can be used to predict the pressure drop and heat transfer coefficient of FC-72 with reasonable accuracy in small channel heat sink designs.
